data: Which language has the best BLI performance in the ADV domain setting at a window size of 5?

The question asks which language has the best BLI performance in the ADV domain setting at a window size of 5. From the caption, we know that Figure 5 shows the BLI performance for each PoS in the different domain settings. The question specifies the ADV domain setting and a window size of 5.

Looking at the graph for the ADV domain setting (the fourth graph on the right), we can see four lines representing the languages fr, de, ru, and ja. Each line corresponds to one language, and the y-axis represents the BLI score.

At a window size of 5, the blue line (fr) is the highest among all the lines, indicating that French (fr) has the best BLI performance in the ADV domain setting at this window size.

Therefore, the answer is French (fr).
